```{r}
# viral features you care about
iav_genes <- c('HA', 'NP', 'NA', 'PB1', 'PB2', 'PA', 'NEP', 'NS1', 'M1', 'M2')

# helper: add any missing features as all-zero rows (so colSums won't error)
add_zero_genes <- function(obj, genes, assay = "RNA") {
  counts <- obj[[assay]]@counts
  missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(counts))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    zero_block <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = length(missing), ncol = ncol(counts), sparse = TRUE)
    rownames(zero_block) <- missing
    colnames(zero_block) <- colnames(counts)
    counts <- rbind(counts, zero_block)
    obj[[assay]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = counts)
  }
  obj
}

## ---- slice22 ----
slice22 <- add_zero_genes(slice22, iav_genes, assay = "RNA")

slice22$infection <- FALSE
slice22$infection_counts <- Matrix::colSums(slice22[['RNA']]@counts[iav_genes, , drop = FALSE])
slice22$infection[slice22$infection_counts > 0] <- TRUE

## ---- slice23 ----
slice23 <- add_zero_genes(slice23, iav_genes, assay = "RNA")

slice23$infection <- FALSE
slice23$infection_counts <- Matrix::colSums(slice23[['RNA']]@counts[iav_genes, , drop = FALSE])
slice23$infection[slice23$infection_counts > 0] <- TRUE

```

```{r}
# SARS-CoV-2 “tripwire” features
sars2_genes <- c("N", "M", "S", "E", "ORF7a")

# helper: add any missing features as all-zero rows (so colSums won't error)
add_zero_genes <- function(obj, genes, assay = "RNA") {
  counts <- obj[[assay]]@counts
  missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(counts))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    zero_block <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = length(missing), ncol = ncol(counts), sparse = TRUE)
    rownames(zero_block) <- missing
    colnames(zero_block) <- colnames(counts)
    counts <- rbind(counts, zero_block)
    obj[[assay]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = counts)
  }
  obj
}

## ---- slice22 ----
slice22 <- add_zero_genes(slice22, sars2_genes, assay = "RNA")

slice22$sars2_negative <- TRUE
slice22$sars2_counts <- Matrix::colSums(slice22[["RNA"]]@counts[sars2_genes, , drop = FALSE])
slice22$sars2_negative[slice22$sars2_counts > 0] <- FALSE

## ---- slice23 ----
slice23 <- add_zero_genes(slice23, sars2_genes, assay = "RNA")

slice23$sars2_negative <- TRUE
slice23$sars2_counts <- Matrix::colSums(slice23[["RNA"]]@counts[sars2_genes, , drop = FALSE])
slice23$sars2_negative[slice23$sars2_counts > 0] <- FALSE
```
